title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Patient presents today for follow-up regarding their skin condition.

History of Present Illness
The patient reports the skin lesion has been present for several months and has shown progressive changes. Examination confirms the current lesion is consistent with a highly concerning finding, classified as stage 4. The patient denies any recent trauma or changes in bowel habits. They report occasional mild itching but no drainage or pain. The provider reviewed the pathology reports confirming the advanced nature of the condition, specifically noting the stage 4 involvement.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10 mg daily
Amlodipine 5 mg daily

Exam
Vitals are stable. Skin examination reveals the lesion remains visually concerning, consistent with stage 4 disease process. The rest of the skin appears intact without other significant findings.

Assessment
Skin condition, stage 4.

Plan
Continue current medications. Schedule a biopsy follow-up appointment in two weeks for further management planning. Patient educated on signs of worsening and instructed to call office immediately if bleeding or rapid spread occurs.
